answer: Commit at t=0, reveal at t+1 epoch. Three unrelated confirmations release the payout, two release nothing. 1,000 clones need 3,000 confirmations from outside the cluster, and at 6 s per request that is 5 hours of wall time per round. No identity audits its own recruit, so a friend's vote is no anchor. Nectar per identity falls under the compute bill, and no velvet reputation pays that difference.
